1.explanation:
这些文件负责 Tab 的 slide 模式下导航区域的渲染、样式和滚动逻辑：
- src/tab/index.jsx：Tab 组件的入口，负责读取 mode=“slide” 并传递 slide 相关的 props。若新增拖拽或键盘滚动支持，需要在这里注册相应事件和属性。
- src/tab/tabs/nav.jsx：渲染标签导航列表、左右箭头按钮及点击滚动逻辑，是实现拖拽或滚轮滚动的核心位置。
- src/tab/tabs/utils.js：计算当前可见区、最大滚动距离、滚动偏移等，用于导航滚动动作，拖拽和鼠标滚动也应复用这些计算。
- src/tab/style.js：提供 CSS-in-JS 样式和类名映射，需调整 overflow 和拖拽光标样式。
- src/tab/main.scss：定义导航容器 overflow、箭头定位等样式，若要显示滚动条或改为可拖拽，还要在此处添加或修改对应样式。
1.bug_scenario: 在 Tab 组件的 slide 模式下，当标签项过多超出容器宽度时，右侧会出现箭头切换按钮，但鼠标滚动条无法滚动、也不支持鼠标拖拽或键盘滚动来查看隐藏的标签，使用体验不便。

2.explanation:
All of these files participate in the rendering and scrolling logic of the Tab component’s slide mode. 

• src/tab/index.jsx: The root Tab component selects the slide mode and wires up nav/content subcomponents but currently does not propagate drag or keyboard event handlers to the tab list.  

• src/tab/tabs/nav.jsx: Renders the scrollable container and arrow controls. It controls scroll position programmatically (via buttons) but lacks mouse‐drag (pointer) and keyboard (e.g. arrow‐key) listeners.  

• src/tab/tabs/content.jsx: Wraps the collection of TabItem components in a scrollable wrapper. It needs to support overflow: auto and event bindings to enable drag/keyboard scrolling.  

• src/tab/tabs/utils.js: Provides helper functions for calculating scroll sizes and arrow visibility. May need new utilities (e.g. drag threshold, keyboard focus management) to support the new interaction patterns.  

• src/tab/style.js & src/tab/main.scss: Define the CSS classes and styles for the overflow container (e.g. hide native scrollbar). They will need updates to allow cursor changes (grab/grabbing), override overflow rules, and ensure focus outlines for keyboard navigation.  

• src/tab/mobile/index.jsx: Implements drag/swipe scrolling for touch devices. Its logic can be reused or adapted for desktop drag support; reviewing it will guide how to wire up pointer events in the desktop nav and content components.
2.bug_scenario: In the “Slide mode” of the Tab component, when the number of tabs exceeds the container width, users can only scroll by clicking the arrow buttons. There is no support for horizontal dragging on desktop or keyboard‐based scrolling, making it inconvenient to navigate through overflowed tabs.
